name: cross-model-agent-delegation
description: Deterministic delegation between Claude Code and the Codex CLI, in both directions. Install the half that matches the CLI you drive, or both.

plugins.name: delegate-to-codex
plugins.description: Install in Claude Code. Routes worker tasks out to the Codex CLI (GPT-6 Astra, Sol, Luna).

plugins.name: delegate-to-claude
plugins.description: Install in Codex. Routes worker tasks out to the Claude Code CLI (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5).
